name: Pre- Matric Scholarships Scheme for Scheduled Castes & Others
benefit: The students shall be given a consolidated academic allowance, as follows: 1. **Day Scholar:**- ₹3,500/- per annum1. **Hosteller:** - - Component 1- ₹7,000/- per annum - Component 2- ₹8,000/- per annum (For Class III-X) - In addition, a 10% extra allowance shall be given to Divyang (Disabled) students.
_eligibility_text:
- The scholarships are open to Nationals of India only.
- **Component 1: Pre Matric Scholarship for SC students**

   1. Applicant students should be studying in class IX and X on a full time basis.
   1. Applicant students should belong to a Scheduled Caste.
   1. Parent/Guardian of applicant students income should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum

- **Component 2: Pre-Matric scholarship for children of parents/guardians engaged in Unclean and hazardous Occupation**

   1. The students should be studying in classes I to X on a full time basis.
   1. Scholarship will be admissible to the children/wards of parents/guardians who, irrespective of their caste/religion belong to one of the following categories

      - Persons who are Manual Scavengers.
      - Tanners & Flayers.
      - Waste pickers.
      - Persons engaged in hazardous cleaning.

   1. There is no family income ceiling under this component of the Scheme.

- Eligible for one scholarship at a time for classes I to X. Notify awarding body if another scholarship is received.
